source_reference_independent_review.method: One bounded read-only review; reused author offline test evidence and did not repeat the full native suite or perform paid calls.
findings: Secure credential refresh is restricted to the original pending input and exact three-event sequence, exact metadata and unchanged settings/scope/model binding. Cancel, steer and revocation do not refresh the admission.
Native source branch invokes the pinned upstream through documents.execute and exits before the candidate run_once loop. Existing source tests explicitly fail if candidate run_once is used.
Only source owner-input tool has native timeout:none; ActiveDeadline excludes authenticated owner waits and rejects late answers after abort. Business tools retain their deadline.

Source test/save and post-save verification use the existing meter; context retains the metered probe callable and refreshed server-produced facts. Post-save results are observed tool evidence, not injected owner instructions.
limitations: No paid GLM or formal activation evidence is established by these fixture/source tests.

Existing cancellation evidence covers HTTP owner-wait cancellation and late callback rejection. A native timeout:none tool with an indefinitely pending RPC has not been end-to-end tested for immediate cancellation; the upstream parent-abort behavior is a static integration assumption.

reference_recovery_independent_review.method: Read actual adapter/worker/admission/meter code and upstream hydration implementation; reuse author native boundary tests, no redundant rerun.
findings: Fresh session creation is excluded on resume; the same SQLite session and target must exist.

Approval interruption happens after durable exact request/preview persistence and before policy return. Receipt interruption occurs after actual write return and before admission settlement/native response.

Resume checks binding/model/store, invokes upstream resumeFromStore, records interrupted native tools, does not approve/replay operations or resend original prompt. Upstream hydrator itself turns pending/running tools into interrupted tool results.
Recreated host admission does not adopt an old in-flight operation. No RPC is permitted by this explicitly readback-only recovery path; this is not proof of a full resumed autonomous run.
Author fixtures prove different real Node PIDs, one R03 PUT, unchanged original IDs/budget/readback and no candidate run_once. They explicitly retain case_pass=false.
limitations: No real GLM or formal recovery scores yet.
R05 streaming remains an adapter gap to close through public native APIs; it must not be misclassified as upstream incapability.
Future changes to recovery execution/streaming must preserve these boundaries and receive only relevant checks.
